blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The prosecution in the International Criminal Court (ICC) is seeking to introduce as evidence the prior recorded testimonies of five unnamed witnesses. These persons could allegedly detail the so-called kill list of former President Rodrigo Duterte and an alleged rewards system for police officers involved in the war against illegal drugs. The prosecutors made the request in their latest filing dated Oct. 12 made public early Saturday. They asked the Trial Chamber (TC) III to admit the testimonies of witnesses identified only as P-1087, P-1151, P-1158, P-1161 and P-1204 into evidence.
